searchText: could this cause problems with the merge if this group (https://www.ethereumgenesys.org/) is planning to keep the PoW chain going at the merge fork? Should be perfectly fine. My own 10 Ethereum forks are also alive and kicking if you're interested in those The most annoying thing would be long reorgs ("attack"), but just keeping the PoW chain alive after the merge is not that It's probably better that there are such groups as they'll keep hashing right up to the merge
